title: chore: d/control to prefer cloud-init-azure meta pkg as alternative to cloud-init
commit_message:
chore: d/control to prefer cloud-init-azure meta pkg as alternative to cloud-init

Define "Depends: cloud-init-azure | cloud-init" alternatives which can be
installed in Ubuntu Azure cloud-images.

Prefer Azure-specific deb package cloud-init-azure as an alternative to the
generic cloud-init deb to avoid depending on generic python dependencies
which and not required for Azure runtime.

The cloud-init-azure package is a meta package which depends on both
cloud-init-base and python3-passlib which are the minimal required dependencies
for Azure cloud-init runtime operations.

This change provides for creating smaller Azure-specific cloud images.
